actionable.title: Bind the settings used for probes to the approved policy bytes
actionable.problem: main hashes the policy at line 425, performs Git inventory and workspace scanning, then validates the cached inventory at line 467 while reading settings again at line 474. A settings change during the scan is parsed and used without comparing its new bytes to the external pin. A deterministic harmless fixture edit produced required_ok=true and Node/Pi/uv probes while the receipt claimed the earlier settings hash. This is a stale-snapshot/source-binding failure; no arbitrary execution by Pi was demonstrated.
actionable.fix: Parse settings from the same verified bytes used for the baseline comparison and detect policy changes across the scan/probe window before permitting probes or issuing a successful receipt. Add a regression that changes settings after the initial inventory and requires failure with no probes.
actionable.reproduction: Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 <workspace>/task-work/adversarial-review/safety/reproduce.py. It uses a synthetic approved manifest, changes only synthetic settings at entry to the real workspace scan, mocks version commands, and records exit 0, required_ok true, tool probes called, and different actual versus approved/receipt settings hashes in safety/reproduction.json.

notes: Independent OpenAI session substantive safety/evidence review only. This is not different-provider approval; exact model ID was not exposed. The issue52 different-provider gate remains cannot_proceed.

Actual policy owner approval/pin and the original 105-key journal remain outstanding and are explicitly stated in the PR; self-created approval identity is outside the documented trusted-caller threat model, not an authentication claim.

CI is pull_request/push with contents:read and pinned actions, not pull_request_target execution. Historical native Windows receipt names the initial PR and merge checkout and explicitly excludes the final Git inventory fix and school-PC acceptance; no network re-verification or native Windows tests performed here.

R07 receipt predecessor/log/candidate/audit hashes match. Hash chains and exclusive-create writes support local change detection, not authenticated timestamps or a malicious Git author resistant immutable ledger; the README states these limits.
PM receipt retains Unity and reconstruction RSS failures, and no runtime/field/HMD approval is inferred.

Original bundled regression invocation made temporary automatically-cleaned fixtures in the test helper default ignored repository scratch directory. A second invocation explicitly set CLAUDE_JOB_DIR to safety so fixtures stayed under the review workspace; no tracked source or frozen target changed.
